fields.summary_ko.0: Management gaps at Nvidia have highlighted the concentration risk of relying on a single AI hardware supplier, increasing attention to TSMC and AI chip equipment manufacturers.
fields.summary_ko.1: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC), based on NT$4.94 trillion in foundry segment revenue, supplies advanced accelerators to AMD, Intel, and hyperscalers beyond Nvidia, while ACM Research supplies advanced packaging tools with $1.14B in semiconductor equipment revenue.
